messages.author: Affairs and Order
messages.text: <@1180720719060029500> Fixed and live. Only some buildings (farms, steel mills, power plants etc) have workers, the rest (refineries, mines, banks...) never did, they just don't need staff. The card used to leave the line out so it looked like the number vanished. It now says 'Employs no workers' on those. If you meant something else (the jobs numbers on the province overview?), tell me and I'll look.

messages.author: Andy
messages.text:
dont they employ janitors

even a small number of people

messages.author: Affairs and Order
messages.text: <@1180720719060029500> Fair point, a refinery with zero staff is a bit silly. Right now only 14 building types have workers and the other 41 don't, that's how the game has been built since the start, I just made the card say it. Giving them a small number of workers is doable but it changes job totals and production for everyone, so I'm not rushing it. I've put it on Dede's list. If you want it, a suggestion post for it would help.

messages.text: I feel like alot of employment issues get fixed when you no longer need the population of a small city of university students to work there
